scope: One prescribed m=3 small-time fixture; no parameter sweep, no increased precision, no all-length rank claim.

column_normalization.convention: Powers of epsilon multiplying the actual columns.

row_convention: Ordinary-r residues of output 1 and output 2/epsilon^2, interleaved at the nine moving poles.

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.

scalar_control.projective_rule: Existing points are -X; row-form residues are homogeneous of degree two, so they agree. Divide by dL/dr, apply the column powers, and use output2=-output0-output1.
scalar_control.warning: This control evaluates the rational construction directly. It does not evaluate truncated Taylor series at epsilon=2.

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.

determinant.precision_argument: Minimum-valuation pivoting factors epsilon^v from the whole residual block before the unit Schur update, then restores it. Every residual entry retains absolute precision 17; each inverse has precision 17-v.
determinant.coefficient_argument: Every selected pivot has valuation below 17; its valuation and leading coefficient are exact. Multiply the eighteen pivot leading terms and the two permutation signs.

status: PASS: actual normalized residue series, independent unit control, leading rank and determinant leading term certified.
resource_measurement_scope: Calculation before JSON serialization; guard remains active during writing.
